claims.evidence: No photo shows the camera powered on; the witness report lists power-on and function as not shown.
No batteries are visible in Photo 0 or Photo 1.
No silicone case is visible in Photo 0 or Photo 1.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or function correctly.
risks.proof: Short video of the camera turning on, navigating menus, taking a picture, and displaying it.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working body for parts or repair.

risks.risk: Shutter count is unknown or high.
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of the camera's shutter-actuation count / info screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-mileage with unknown shutter life.

risks.risk: Sensor has dust, scratches, or dead pixels.
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor with mirror locked up, or a test shot of a plain wall at small aperture.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing sensor cleaning or repair.

risks.risk: Buttons, dials, or autofocus are faulty.
risks.proof: Video showing all dials and buttons responding and autofocus locking on a subject.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as controls or autofocus may be defective.

risks.risk: Batteries and charger are missing, dead, or not included.
risks.proof: Photo of two batteries and a charger, plus video of the camera running on battery power.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without battery and charger; buyer must source them.

risks.proof: Photo of a memory card in the slot or beside the camera.

risks.risk: No original warranty documents or purchase receipt.
risks.proof: Photo of the original receipt or warranty card.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with no warranty or proof of purchase.

risks.risk: Hidden history of drops, repairs, or water damage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the body for dents, corrosion, or repair marks, plus any service records.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly damaged or previously repaired.

risks.risk: Ports and slots (USB, HDMI, memory card) do not work.
risks.proof: Video or photo showing a cable connected to USB/HDMI and a card read in the slot.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as ports and slots may be faulty.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing it.
Photo or screenshot of the shutter count / camera info screen.
Close-up photo of the sensor with mirror locked up.
Photo of the two batteries and charger.
Close-up photos of the body for dents, corrosion, or repair marks.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Nikon D7100 body, so the item can be priced at its worst case as a non-working body; unproven function and accessories would raise the price once verified.
